decisions.reason: After four years the uncertainty has largely resolved, and in a crowded conferencing market this adjacent service offers too little strategic upside versus the firm's stronger network and cloud options.
Metropolitan data-centre interconnection fits the firm's core infrastructure strategy and showed early adoption, so it remains a valuable growth option worth retaining.
Optical spectrum connectivity builds directly on owned fibre assets and the move toward high-bandwidth services, so its strategic value still justifies keeping it on the market.
Although tied to a mature voice segment, the ordering portal is likely inexpensive to maintain and can still support the installed customer base, so management would keep the option open for now.

Direct voice network connection is now a more mature and less strategic offer, and after several years the option value appears low enough that resources are better redeployed to newer software-defined connectivity services.
